ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( (NSP_Has_Evergreen_Products__c > 0), ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Type__c, 'Amendment'), (NSP_TransactionType__c == 'Termination'), ISCHANGED(NSP_TerminationDate__c), OR( /* Rule for all users - must be last day of month */ (DAY(NSP_TerminationDate__c) != IF( (MONTH(NSP_TerminationDate__c) = 12), 31, DAY( DATE( YEAR(NSP_TerminationDate__c), (MONTH(NSP_TerminationDate__c) + 1), 1 ) - 1 ) )), AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Termination_Date_Validation), NSP_TerminationDate__c < DATE( YEAR(TODAY()) + IF(MONTH(TODAY()) = 1, -1, 0), IF(MONTH(TODAY()) = 1, 12, MONTH(TODAY()) - 1), DAY(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1) - 1) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Termination Date must be the last day of the month. You may select either the end of last month or a future month-end date.
